thread:
sam (Support): FYI customer acme-inc reports a spike of 503s starting ~09:02 UTC, several request IDs attached. They say it started right after a model hot-swap. sample req: req=acme-11f3a, trace=trace-998. Can we triage?

maria (SRE): Looking at runner logs for that pool now. Early signs: repeated `SIGABRT` from the inference worker, followed by container restart.

oliver (Infra): I see the same in node gpu-4. Kernel shows a stack overflow/fault during prefetch on the quantized runtime. Collecting dmesg and core dump.

sam (Support): Customer impact: ~120 requests failed over 3m, mostly streaming and toolcall flows; they got 503 or truncated stream. They're asking for a root cause and ETA.

diane (Eng-ML): Could be the prefetch codepath when KV cache is empty + large context. We recently merged a tiny optimization for empty-prefetch short-circuiting. Might be regressing on certain GPUs.

maria (SRE): Pasting the relevant log snippet from runner (trimmed):
```
[2026-03-18T09:02:10Z] infer-runner[pid=4321] ERROR: signal SIGABRT (6) at pc=0x7f8a1b2c
Stack: 0x7fff... 0x7f8a1b2c 0x55aa...
runtime: frame pointer missing, possible stack overflow in thread 12
prefetch: kv_fetch_range size=0 seq=8192 model=redwood-v1-q4
```

oliver (Infra): dmesg from the host shows `kernel: NVRM: GPU has fallen off the bus` within seconds of that abort. NV driver gave a reset. Not typical OOM Gpu; looks like a device fault after illegal memory access.

deploy-bot: Rollout event: `hot-swap redwood-v1-q4 -> redwood-v1-q4a` started at 2026-03-18T09:01:55Z in pool hosted-prod-gpu-4.

diane (Eng-ML): That `q4a` variant toggles a narrower fused-kernel path for attention to speed up short prefixes. If a kernel has a bounds-check bug it could corrupt stack when prefetch size==0.

maria (SRE): Repro attempt on canary with same model variant: reproduced SIGABRT within ~10s under a streaming+toolcall load that includes empty KV prefetch triggers. I captured a short backtrace:
```
#0  0x7f8a1b2c in fused_attention_forward+0x4c (kernel.o)
#1  0x55aa2b3e in prefetch_and_dispatch
#2  0x55aa4f11 in handle_stream_request
#3  0x7f8b9a0c in start_thread
```

sam (Support): Should we rollback the hot-swap to reduce customer impact? CS is asking for mitigation asap.

cs-oncall: CS already opened a support incident with Acme and offered a short-term retry/backoff recommendation; they prefer a platform-side mitigation if possible.

oliver (Infra): I can pin that pool back to the previous model revision (redwood-v1-q4) for hosted-prod-gpu-4 and drain new requests from will schedule within 2m. Rolling back now unless objection.

diane (Eng-ML): +1 rollback. We'll prepare a patch to disable the fused-kernel on q4a until we root cause and add a unit test around empty-prefetch.

maria (SRE): After rollback of pool hosted-prod-gpu-4 at 09:08 UTC failures dropped to baseline. No more SIGABRTs in that pool. Keeping canary blocked.

sam (Support): Noted, told Acme we're rolling back and will follow up with a timeline for a fix. They asked for any temporary guidance: should they reduce batch sizes or disable streaming?

diane (Eng-ML): Short-term guidance: avoid toolcall streams that trigger empty KV prefetch (i.e., prefix length=0 with `prefetch=true`) — use explicit small prefix or disable prefetch. We'll publish a short KB.

maria (SRE): Action items:
- infra/oliver: keep pool pinned to redwood-v1-q4 until a patched q4a build passes canary and memory/stack fuzzing (owner: oliver, ETA: 4h).
- eng-ml/diane: produce patch disabling fused-kernel or add bounds-check; add regression test for empty-prefetch (owner: diane, ETA: 8h).
- support/sam: share mitigation KB and customer timeline (owner: sam, ETA: 1h).

oliver (Infra): Done pinning; added a traffic rule and monitoring alert to detect similar GPU device faults and to auto-evict canary variant.

deploy-bot: Rollback complete: `redwood-v1-q4a` replaced with `redwood-v1-q4` in pool hosted-prod-gpu-4 at 2026-03-18T09:08:12Z.

maria (SRE): Follow-up: capturing full coredumps and kernel trace, uploading to s3://redwood-incident-dumps/4321009876/ for eng-ml. Also starting a short fuzz harness against fused_attention_forward on a test node.

sam (Support): Thanks all — I'll send the customer an update now. Marking this thread for postmortem if patch lands slowly. :thumbsup:

maria (SRE): We'll keep this thread updated. If anyone finds new SIGABRTs post-rollout, ping immediately.

(End of thread)
